channel.title: Orielsy Diaz — Research & Writing
channel.description: Technical essays, architecture explorations, and systems design by Orielsy Diaz.

item.title: Context Zen: When More Context Stops Helping
item.description: An experimental context-engineering skill that watches long-running AI conversations, distills authoritative working state, and creates continuation handoffs before accumulated history becomes a liability.

item.title: Which Parts of Today’s Framework Become Tomorrow’s Platform?
item.description: A preliminary investigation into how Signals, Web Components, native navigation, View Transitions, DOM primitives, and Open UI may shift responsibilities from frameworks into the web platform.

item.title: From Prompts to Project Memory: Spec-Driven Development for Coding Agents
item.description: A repository-grounded look at using version-controlled specs, decisions, and project rules as durable memory for coding agents across long-running software work.

item.title: Architecture Notes: Audio Chunking, Transcription Filtering, and Real-Time Speech UI Systems
item.description: A technical exploration of streaming audio chunk management, Whisper transcription filtering, and Electron overlay rendering, grounded in the current public speechBubbles and whisper-api source.

item.title: Documentation-Driven Adaptive UX
item.description: Exploring how enterprise product knowledge can become contextual interface behavior through deterministic state, validation, authored guidance, and evidence-aware response policy.

item.title: Progressive Enhancement for Intelligent Interfaces
item.description: Applying progressive-enhancement thinking to AI: narrow interface capabilities can improve with local or remote inference without making the baseline experience depend on a particular model, provider, or machine.
